title: Evo 2 Designs First Fully AI-Generated Viable Bacteriophages
source: Science (King et al., Stanford / Arc Institute)
key_claim: Evo 1/2 generated ~700k PhiX174-variant genomes; 285 synthesized, 16 viable. Cryo-EM revealed evolutionarily distant proteins. First complete AI-designed viral genomes validated experimentally.
evidence_strength: Experimental synthesis + plaque assay + cryo-EM + efficacy vs antibiotic-resistant E. coli
testability: Immediate: replicate with other scaffolds; scale to larger genomes; C9 biosafety scoring integration
safety_note: Open-source Apache 2.0; commentary: ability to compose viral genomes using generative AI now exists; the governance to safely steer it does not (Inglesby & Hanke, Science)
